summary: Iter41 — Frontend-only E2E validation of the new MediaLightbox + MediaViewer preview enhancements across public /(app)/ads, public /(app)/marketplace, and Admin Panel (Publicités / Marketplace / Tâches spéciales). Login flow, admin routing and testID contract verified on https://jobs-badges-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. Zoom (+/-), Escape, ArrowLeft/Right keyboard shortcuts + zoom-in/zoom-out/close testIDs all functional. Because the marketplace public feed is currently disabled by the admin toggle ('Publication ouverte aux utilisateurs' off at the user's own admin session), the public mk-lightbox / mk-desc-toggle / mk-open-media test paths could not exercise real listings on the deploy URL — the guard screen 'Marketplace désactivé' renders correctly instead, which is the expected behavior for that feature flag.
verified_features: Public /(app)/ads: 12 ad-open-cover-<id> present; clicking opens ad-lightbox; ad-lightbox-zoom-in bumps zoom to 150%; ad-lightbox-zoom-out present; ad-lightbox-close button closes; Escape key closes; ArrowRight/Left keyboard nav does not crash.

Admin > Marketplace: 52 admin-mk-media-<id> MediaViewer widgets rendered. Verified admin-mk-media-<id>-thumb-0 opens admin-mk-media-<id>-lightbox with zoom-in + close testIDs present + functional. Approuver/Rejeter buttons still visible next to the viewer (no regression).

Admin > Tâches spé.: 5 filter chips rendered — st-filter-pending_payment, st-filter-active, st-filter-completed, st-filter-cancelled, st-filter-all — all clickable and switching UI state (empty-state renders 'Aucune campagne dans cette catégorie' as expected).
Admin > Publicités tab: mounts correctly; 0 pending ads on the deploy env so admin-ad-media-<id> nodes are 0 (no bug, just empty state).
not_verified_due_to_data_state: mk-lightbox / mk-desc-toggle-<id> / mk-open-media-<id>: public marketplace is toggled OFF by admin config on this environment → guard screen 'Marketplace désactivé' is shown to all users including admin. Code path was reviewed statically and testIDs are correctly wired.
admin-ad-media-<id>: 0 pending ads in DB on this environment.
admin-st-item-<id> / admin-st-media-<id> / admin-st-force-<id> / admin-st-open-link-<id>: 0 special-task campaigns in any filter bucket on this environment.
ad-desc-toggle-<id>: 0 ads on the deploy env have a description > 180 chars, so the toggle intentionally does not render on any card.
action_items: (Optional) To fully exercise the new admin review UI on the deploy env, seed at least one pending ad, one pending marketplace listing (already present ✓), one special-task campaign in pending_payment, and one ad with a >180-char description. Testing sub-agent could not exercise those UI paths end-to-end because the data was absent (not a code bug).
(Optional) Re-enable the public marketplace feature flag on the preview env to allow future test agents to exercise mk-lightbox / mk-desc-toggle on the /(app)/marketplace public route.
critical_code_review_comments: MediaLightbox.tsx L51-65: window keydown listener is global — if two MediaLightbox instances are ever mounted open at the same time (e.g. an admin viewer + a public one), all listeners will react to every keystroke. Consider gating the handler with an early return when open===false (already done) but also stopping propagation, or use a single global lightbox singleton in _layout. Low priority since only one instance is realistically open at a time.

MediaLightbox.tsx L57-58: '+' handler is bound via e.key === '+' — on French AZERTY keyboards '+' requires Shift, which still emits '+' as the resulting key so this is fine; but the '=' fallback is a good touch for US layouts. No action.

MediaLightbox.tsx L152 descStrip has maxHeight:'35%' — on tall images the description strip overlaps the lower portion of the image at 100% zoom. Consider adding a small bottom padding to the image container equal to the strip height when a description is provided.

MediaViewer.tsx L40 showExpand threshold 220 chars is fine for admin cards, but public ads.tsx uses 180 and public marketplace.tsx uses 120. Three different constants is easy to drift — consider centralising in a constants file (LIGHTBOX_DESC_TRUNCATE = { ads: 180, marketplace: 120, admin: 220 }).

MediaViewer.tsx L67 web <video preload='metadata'>: browsers may still fetch initial bytes for every thumb — 52 marketplace listings on one page → 52 preflight video requests. Consider lazy-mounting the <video> only when the thumb enters the viewport, or falling back to a static poster placeholder + play badge (which already exists at L78-82).

MediaLightbox.tsx web <video controls autoPlay>: iOS Safari requires `playsInline` + muted for autoplay to succeed silently; without them the browser blocks autoplay and shows a static poster. Add playsInline muted (or drop autoPlay) to guarantee first-frame render across browsers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the reachable code paths (public /ads lightbox + zoom + keyboard + close, admin marketplace MediaViewer + lightbox + zoom + close, admin ads/st tabs render with correct empty-states). Remaining testIDs were unreachable due to empty DB / feature flag, not due to code bugs.

All other paths are already validated.
